_**User (2026-05-14 04:11:33Z)**_

is 50K lines of rust impressive

---

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-05-14 04:11:39Z)**_

Not really a useful signal on its own. 50K lines is a medium-sized Rust codebase — bigger than a toy, smaller than ripgrep (~40K), tokio (~80K), or rustc (~1M+). What matters is what those lines *do*: a 50K-line orchestrator with real concurrency, recovery, and TUI is impressive; 50K lines of boilerplate enum matches is not.

Rust also inflates line counts vs. Python/Go because of explicit error handling, derives, and trait impls — so 50K Rust ≈ maybe 20–25K Python in equivalent logic.
